description: Nine-channel mixer with a level and a pan for each channel, summed to a stereo pair through a master level

params.text: Places its own channel between the left and right outputs, at constant power so the loudness holds across the sweep
Sets the level of its own channel, 0% to 100%
Sets the level of the stereo pair after the channels have been summed, 0% to 100%

inputs.text: One channel's signal; a polyphonic cable is summed to mono before that channel's own level and pan

outputs.text: The left side of the stereo mix
The right side of the stereo mix

notes: the channels are summed straight, with no gain compensation and no soft clipping, so use the channel levels to keep the total inside a sensible range.
